## Software

::: {.resource-item}
### NARestraints

Used for non-canonical nucleic acid crystallgraphy, plugging into Phenix environment. 

Infers secondary structure using antiparallel run model. Then generates restraints for WC, WC-like, GU wobble, and AG Hoogsteen pairs based on phenix library. Employs ligand library compiled by Wang, Guo and Vecchioni to screen atom names for bond and angle generation. Tolerant to mislabeled atoms.


<span class="resource-meta">Version 1.0.0 · macOS / Windows / Python</span>

[22-Aug-2026](https://github.com/vecchioni-lab/NARestraints/releases/tag/v1.0.0){.resource-link}
:::


::: {.resource-item}
### Linking Number and other Differential Geometry

Linking number calculator for Matlab, which processes PDB files of DNA tiles. It was developed for our paper on tertiary chirality in 2023: [Janowski, J. et al, “Engineering Tertiary Chirality in Helical Biopolymers.” PNAS 121(19), e2321992121 (2024).](https://doi.org/10.1073/pnas.2321992121).

<span class="resource-meta">Version 1.0 · macOS / Windows / Python</span>

[Download ZIP](assets/software/Differential-Geometry-DNA.zip){.resource-link}
:::
